title: Monitor debt covenants and lender reporting
summary: While a company has a loan, venture-debt or credit agreement with reporting or performance conditions. A reviewed covenant calculation and reporting pack with actual or forecast breaches escalated before the next action.
outcomes: A reviewed covenant calculation and reporting pack with actual or forecast breaches escalated before the next action.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: While a company has a loan, venture-debt or credit agreement with reporting or performance conditions.

parts.title: Extract the operative obligations from signed agreements
parts.guidance: Create a register of covenant definitions, measurement periods, reporting dates, certificates and notice clauses. Record amendments and waivers with their effective dates rather than reusing an outdated term sheet.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Recompute tests from reconciled financial data
parts.guidance: Apply each agreement's definitions to the correct period and show the calculation inputs. Separate actual results from forecasts and identify add-backs or classifications that require lender or adviser confirmation.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review headroom and potential noncompliance
parts.guidance: Finance leadership and counsel resolve interpretation questions and assess projected headroom. Route an actual default to the covenant-default response process instead of assuming a waiver or netting a breach against another metric.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Approve and deliver the required lender reports
parts.guidance: The designated signatory reviews the final certificate and attachments before delivery through the agreed channel. Retain the submitted version and evidence of receipt, with confidential materials access-controlled.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve and deliver the required lender reports

parts.title: Track responses and the next measurement cycle
parts.guidance: Record questions, approvals and any signed waiver without treating silence as consent. Refresh the liquidity forecast and assign follow-up for conditions, remediation and upcoming reporting dates.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

verify.how: A reviewed covenant calculation and reporting pack with actual or forecast breaches escalated before the next action.
